title: Fix Reverse Charge VAT upgrade migration
summary: Corrected field mappings and filtering logic in the Reverse Charge VAT upgrade migration to properly transfer legacy values into new GB fields using type-correct filters.
key_points: Fixed reversed source and destination field ID mappings across setup, item, and sales/purchase tables
Replaced blank-text filters with type-correct defaults for Boolean and Decimal fields
Removed unnecessary VAT Amount Line transfer and unused namespace import
Added optimization to skip writes when source and target values already match
Properly closed record references to prevent resource leaks
quote: Correct the migration to copy legacy values into the new GB fields using type-correct filters.
